# Billboard AD BD

> Billboard advertising across Bangladesh: 26 static billboard locations in 10 cities plus highway routes. Call or WhatsApp +880 1847-790122. No published rates; quotes on request.

## Pages

- [Find a billboard](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/): all locations on one map
- [Highway billboards](https://billboardadbd.com/highway-billboards/): Dhaka-Chattogram, Padma Bridge, Dhaka-Sylhet and more
- [Billboards in Dhaka](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/dhaka/): Science Lab Circle-2, Hotel Sakura / InterContinental, Mohakhali SKS Tower-2, Mirpur-10 Circle, Shahbag
- [Billboards in Chattogram](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/chattogram/): GEC Circle, Jamalkhan, Kadamtali Circle
- [Billboards in Sylhet](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/sylhet/): Bondor Bazar, Chowkideki Point, Nairpul Point, Rikabi Bazar, Jitu Miah Point, Surma Point, Tilagor Point, Uposhohor
- [Billboards in Rajshahi](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/rajshahi/): Shaheb Bazar, New Market
- [Billboards in Cox's Bazar](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/coxs-bazar/): Sughondha Point, Kolatoli
- [Billboards in Cumilla](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/cumilla/): Kandirpar
- [Billboards in Feni](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/feni/): Feni town
- [Billboards in Barishal](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/barishal/): Barishal Launch Terminal (outside), Barishal Launch Terminal (inside)
- [Billboards in Tangail](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/tangail/): Nirala Circle
- [Billboards in Narayanganj](https://billboardadbd.com/billboards/narayanganj/): Narayanganj city
